retrievalProfile.description: A low-key group portrait featuring subjects with multi-colored paisley bandanas covering their faces, paired with bold outlined display typography in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: group of men wearing colorful bandanas as masks
dark moody group photography with vibrant fabric accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, triangular group composition of several men against a dark background, where each individual wears a differently colored paisley bandana (green, red, purple, blue, yellow) as a mask, creating a high-contrast focal point against dark clothing and shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant fabric colors against a desaturated dark background
Repetitive paisley patterns across multiple subjects
Triangular group stacking creating depth and density
Direct eye contact from subjects above the mask line
coreInvariants: Subjects must wear bandanas covering the nose and mouth
Each bandana must be a distinct, saturated primary or secondary color
Lighting must be directional and moody, leaving the background in deep shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A dense cluster of subjects filling the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged in a tiered, overlapping formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground with a bright yellow bandana serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bright bandanas in the center outward to the dark edges, then up to the high-contrast typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space occupies the top left and provides a backdrop for the text in the top right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark earth tones in clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Saturated primary colors (Red, Blue, Yellow) and secondary colors (Green, Purple) in the bandanas.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the graphic typography and highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the small areas of fabric against a very low-value, low-saturation environment.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weight with rounded terminals
Primary title uses thick white outlines with hollow centers
Secondary title uses solid fills with a specific graphic strike-through on the 'O'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the secondary text features a diagonal red slash or strike-through
The 'W' and 'A' in the primary title are tightly kerned to touch or overlap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked sans-serifs where the top is outlined and the bottom is solid for weight contrast.

preserve: Outlined style for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and heavy weight of the skeleton.
Provides the necessary geometric structure for the 'W' and 'A'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group portrait of seven men in a dark room, arranged in a tight cluster. Each man wears a different colored paisley bandana (green, red, purple, light blue, yellow, dark red) covering the lower half of his face. Low-key lighting, dark clothing, black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top right corner. The top line should be a large, heavy geometric sans-serif with a thick white outline and no fill. The bottom line should be a smaller, solid white geometric sans-serif with a red diagonal slash through the letter 'O'.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting moody and low-key?
Is the top text outlined and the bottom text solid?
Does the 'O' have a graphic strike-through?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: High contrast between bandanas and background
Sharp focus on the eyes of the subjects

postGenerationChecks: Check that all subjects have visible eyes above the masks
Ensure the paisley pattern is recognizable on the fabric
Verify the text is positioned in the upper right quadrant
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark to make the colors pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Group Portrait + Multi-colored Bandana Masks + Low-Key Lighting + Geometric Outlined Typography
